tools.name: quote
tools.description: Discover the x402 v2 HTTP checkout URL, network, USDC price and terms for a standard service.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Submit a demo or supervised order using a fresh order bearer token in the HTTP Authorization header. Use the quote tool for automated x402 checkout.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch order status and inline result using the same bearer token.

tools.name: accept_order
tools.description: Record acceptance of a delivered result using the same bearer token.
